My base case starts first-year growth below the guided rate, because Home Comfort Solutions volume is still falling and the EPS range was lowered. It starts above the trailing and three-year rates because acquired revenue is added. It then fades to a terminal rate a little below the three-year compound rate and below the risk-free rate of {cost_of_capital.risk_free_rate|pct}. The bear case starts below the three-year rate and the bull case above the five-year rate.

most_sensitive.assumption: Operating margin, year one and year ten
most_sensitive.reading: No sensitivity grid was computed, because the valuation it varies was not computed (the valuation.missing reason quoted under the value range). There is also no scenario spread to read. Python's output therefore cannot show which assumption value depends on most. Against the record, operating margin is where my three cases differ most. The bear case ends near fiscal 2023's {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.operating_margin|pct}. The base case ends between fiscal 2024's {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.operating_margin|pct} and fiscal 2025's {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_margin|pct}. The bull case ends above every year on record. The starting point is uncertain too. The trailing margin of {ratios.profitability.operating_margin|pct} includes tariff refunds that the release calls earlier than expected. The June quarter's gross margin of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct} is the highest of the filled quarters. Part of the recent margin comes from the change from LIFO to FIFO, which the inputs do not size.

most_sensitive.assumption: Revenue growth, and terminal growth against the discount rate
most_sensitive.reading: No grid value exists here either. My cases put first-year growth anywhere from below the three-year compound rate of {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound|pct} (bear) to above the five-year rate of {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_five_year_compound|pct} (bull). Trailing growth is {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct}. Terminal growth runs from below the three-year compound rate to just above it, and every case is under the risk-free rate of {cost_of_capital.risk_free_rate|pct}. In this formula the terminal value depends on the gap between terminal growth and the WACC. That gap cannot be measured here because the WACC is missing. The reinvestment shares were set against a trailing return on invested capital of {ratios.profitability.return_on_invested_capital|pct}. The bear case reinvests more for less growth and the bull case less for more, so the cases also assume different returns on new capital.

In any case no valuation was computed, so there is no valuation.accounting_adjustments figure. The items the accounting reader flagged but could not size were handled through my driver choices instead. The base case starts operating margin below the trailing {ratios.profitability.operating_margin|pct} because the quarter's gross margin of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct} includes the one-time refunds. It holds the long-run margin below fiscal 2025's {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_margin|pct}, partly because the change from LIFO to FIFO raises recent margins by an amount the inputs do not state.

summary_ko.value_range: 기준일 주가 자료가 없어 베타, 자기자본비용, 가중평균자본비용(WACC)을 계산하지 못했습니다. 그래서 시나리오별 기업가치와 주당 가치 범위도 계산되지 않았고, 무위험이자율 {cost_of_capital.risk_free_rate|pct}, 세전 타인자본비용 {cost_of_capital.pre_tax_cost_of_debt|pct} 같은 일부 구성요소만 계산되었으며 여기서 가치를 따로 추정하지는 않습니다.
summary_ko.price_position: 계산기에 기준일 주가도 가치 범위도 없으므로, 주가가 가치 범위의 어디쯤에 있는지는 말할 수 없습니다. 잉여현금흐름 수익률 같은 보조 지표도 같은 이유로 계산되지 않았습니다.
summary_ko.market_implied_growth: WACC가 없어 역DCF를 돌리지 못했으므로, 주가에 담긴 성장률은 알 수 없습니다. 비교할 과거 매출 성장률은 최근 세 해 연평균 {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound|pct}, 다섯 해 연평균 {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_five_year_compound|pct}, 최근 네 분기 {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct}이며, 회사의 올해 매출 성장 가이던스는 대부분 인수 효과에서 나옵니다.
summary_ko.most_sensitive: 민감도 표가 계산되지 않아, 가치가 어느 가정에 가장 민감한지는 계산 결과로 말할 수 없습니다. 다만 세 시나리오가 과거 기록에 비해 가장 크게 갈리는 가정은 영업이익률(2023 회계연도 {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.operating_margin|pct} 수준부터 2025 회계연도 {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_margin|pct}를 넘는 수준까지)과 매출 성장률입니다.
summary_ko.accounting_adjustments: 회계 분석가가 작성한 조정이 없고 가치평가도 계산되지 않았으므로, 회계 조정 때문에 달라진 가치는 없습니다. 대신 이번 분기 매출총이익률 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}에 섞인 일회성 관세 환급을 감안해, 기본 시나리오의 첫해 영업이익률을 최근 네 분기 {ratios.profitability.operating_margin|pct}보다 낮게 잡았습니다.

limits: This valuation is a set of stated assumptions run through a stated formula. It states no recommendation to trade, and a different reader choosing different drivers would reach a different value.
